defects.issue: Link depicted as two tall parallel prongs rather than a U-shape with upper/lower horizontal legs and connecting bight
Main U-bracket not clearly formed; mounting wall and base wall relationship unclear
Door-half leaf flange represented as flat plates with no channel/leaf profile matching the patent
Pintle pin shown disconnected below the assembly rather than passing through aligned holes on the vertical axis
No representation of vehicle body/door panels as context surfaces
No discernible stop feature on pin or link
Upper/lower extensions appear as straight vertical bars instead of horizontal parallel extensions

notes: The CAD captures the general idea of two bracket-like bodies with a pin and hole features, but the characteristic U-shape of both the main member and the link, plus the horizontal upper/lower extension/leg geometry, are not recreated. Arrangement along a vertical pintle axis is not convincingly shown.
